One person said I could get a replacement chair and a cushion, the next person said I couldn't then returned everything when I didn't want to return them. Then out of the blue they tried to ship me another sofa which I had to cancel myself through the shipping company. After a month of this headache I returned everything via the shipping method and company Walmart chose. Now Walmart is saying I only returned the sofa set and refuses to refund me for the chairs which were returned along with the sofa. I literally helped the driver load all of the items into his truck! I have even spoken with the shipping company and they assured me they received all of the pieces, including the chairs, and turned them over to Walmart the following day. Walmart is still refusing to refund my money and is no longer answering my emails to customer service. I know this is a popular item with Instagram influencers and my experience has proved that Walmart doesn't care about its normal customers only those that advertise for them.

top_negative.title: Frame, Trays, Hanging Knobs Rust in Under a Year!
top_negative.text: I purchased this Blackstone less than a year ago and have been very disappointed with the durability of the exterior components. After only 9 months of ownership, the frame, shelves, hanging knobs, and other painted surfaces are already showing significant rust and corrosion. In several areas, the coating is flaking off entirely. What's particularly frustrating is that I have taken excellent care of the griddle. The cooking surface itself remains in great condition because I regularly clean and season it. The unit has also been stored under a covered patio in Ohio and has not been subjected to unusually harsh conditions. I could understand seeing this level of corrosion after 5–10 years of use, but not within the first year of ownership. For a premium-priced product that is intended for outdoor use, I expected far better quality and durability from the structural components and finish. I chose Blackstone over less expensive competitors because I believed I was paying for superior quality. Unfortunately, the rapid deterioration of the frame and exterior parts has left me disappointed. I hope Blackstone stands behind its products and can provide a satisfactory resolution.

When I tried to scrape the grill down the burner covers stripped off the finish. The hotdog upper grill was already rusty even though hotdogs had only been on it once. Am very aggravated with it and feel ripped off. Wish I had my old grill back because the metal materials were much better and my food wouldn't slip between the racks.
